candidates.name: hyperliquid_builder_liquidation_panel
candidates.notes: Hyperliquid account-day panel (RPANEL.parquet, ODC-BY). liq_same binary label per account-day. SAME VENUE as FCLR-010 (Hyperliquid perpetuals) - the only new Hyperliquid liquidation signal found. BUT: RPANEL.parquet is 1.06 GB (unbounded download), and the label is account-day liquidation-anywhere, not the FCLR-010 liquidation-notional intensity target. Schema (d,address,grp,b,npos,lev,ltype,gross,av,buf,liq_same,traded,mo) is NOT compatible with FCLR-010 (needs timestamp,symbol,mark_price,funding_rate). Requires new protocol version. REVIEW_REQUIRED pending bounded coverage probe.
